description:
Electrical schematic sheet 27 of 27 for PLC analog-output module “5 AO”, WAGO type 750-559, CPU 750-8213, position 28. The module provides four analog control outputs to four winch valve/control devices through Connector Type H interfaces. No fuse, circuit breaker, switch, contactor, relay, or other protective device is drawn or identified on this sheet; therefore a protective-device identifier/rating and board/row cannot be extracted here. The only field supply shown is the +24 Vdc (field) bus entering from cross-reference 16.8A and continuing off-sheet to the right. The 0 V bus enters from cross-reference 20.7B and continues off-sheet to the right. Each remote Connector Type H circuit has Udc, Us, and GND: Udc is the +24 Vdc field supply, Us is the analog command/control signal from the applicable PLC AO channel, and GND is the common/return tied to the module M/0 V circuit. These analog signal lines are control commands, not protective power feeds. The module lower 0 V/common is bonded to the sheet 0 V bus by a wire marked “04.6 BK 1,5” (black, 1.5 mm² as printed).

Circuit 1 — Primary winch port, EV 10.5: valve/electrohydraulic control device (exact valve subtype is not explicitly printed). Supply path: incoming +24 Vdc (field), source cross-reference 16.8A → left vertical field-supply branch → Connector Type H terminal Udc → device interface. No protective device identifier or rating is shown on this sheet. Control path: PLC module 5 AO, AO-01 CH 01, terminal A1 → Us at Connector Type H → EV 10.5. Return/status reference: device GND → module M/0 V common. No separate status, feedback, monitoring, or alarm-system tap is shown. Connector cross-reference: “CONNECTOR TYPE H (see sheet 4)”.

Circuit 2 — Secondary winch port, EV 10.4: valve/electrohydraulic control device (exact valve subtype is not explicitly printed). Supply path: incoming +24 Vdc (field), source cross-reference 16.8A → right vertical field-supply branch → Connector Type H terminal Udc → device interface. No protective device identifier or rating is shown. Control path: PLC 5 AO, AO-01 CH 02, terminal A2 → Us at Connector Type H → EV 10.4. Return/status reference: GND → module M/0 V. No separate status, feedback, monitoring, or alarm tap is drawn. Cross-reference: Connector Type H, see sheet 4.

Circuit 3 — Primary winch stbd, EV 8.4: valve/electrohydraulic control device (exact valve subtype is not explicitly printed). Supply path: +24 Vdc (field), cross-reference 16.8A → left vertical branch → Connector Type H Udc → device interface. No protective-device identifier/rating is shown. Control path: PLC 5 AO, AO-01 CH 03, terminal A3 → Us at Connector Type H → EV 8.4. Return/status reference: GND → module M/0 V. No separate monitoring/alarm tap is shown. Cross-reference: Connector Type H, see sheet 4.

Circuit 4 — Secondary winch stbd, EV 8.3: valve/electrohydraulic control device (exact valve subtype is not explicitly printed). Supply path: +24 Vdc (field), cross-reference 16.8A → right vertical branch → Connector Type H Udc → device interface. No protective-device identifier/rating is shown. Control path: PLC 5 AO, AO-01 CH 04, terminal A4 → Us at Connector Type H → EV 8.3. Return/status reference: GND → module M/0 V. No separate monitoring/alarm tap is shown. Cross-reference: Connector Type H, see sheet 4.

PLC module topology: channels A1/A2 have corresponding M common terminals below; channels A3/A4 have corresponding M common terminals below. The four field circuits share the shown 24 Vdc field and 0 V distribution. The +24 Vdc and 0 V buses continue beyond this sheet as indicated by right-pointing arrows; their destination sheet/reference is printed only as “--”. Document title block identifies project SWS_108-1, title HYDRAULIC SYSTEM AUTOMATION, section AFT, revision 4, date 05/05/2026, client S.W. SHIPYARD, file SWS_108-1_AFT PLC.dwg.
